features.title: Models, scenario loading, board management
features.user_visible_behavior: Pydantic models validate scenario YAML. Workspace directories are created with correct state, narrative, and history files.

features.title: Domain rules in agent prompts
features.user_visible_behavior: Scenario rules are injected into agent prompts, filtered by applies_to. Rules appear in the Governing Rules section of each prompt.
evidence: test_rules_loaded and test_rules_in_prompt passing as of 2026-08-13

features.title: Wildcard catastrophic events
features.user_visible_behavior: Wildcard events fire stochastically per step. Event file is written to board for agents to read. Includes asteroid, gamma ray, volcano, snowball, alien, deus ex machina.
features.notes: state_impact is advisory only — not auto-applied to state. Known gap.

features.title: Entity/population model and workspace setup
features.user_visible_behavior: Scenarios with entities merge per-entity initial_state into the shared world state. Entity types: population, force, critic, evaluator.
features.notes: Interaction logic (can_interact_with, InteractionConfig) declared in model but NOT implemented in loop.

features.title: Analysis and outcome aggregation
features.user_visible_behavior: Trajectories are classified post-hoc, outcomes counted, rates computed, text report generated.

features.title: Fix _fallback_resolution to use deep merge
features.user_visible_behavior: When no judge is available, fallback resolution deep-merges proposals instead of overwriting.
verification: Add test: two proposals with overlapping nested keys both survive in fallback resolution.
features.notes: Currently uses dict.update() which silently drops earlier proposals' keys.

features.title: Auto-apply wildcard state_impact to board state
features.user_visible_behavior: When a wildcard fires, its state_impact is directly applied to state.json in addition to being written as a file for agents.
verification: Add test: wildcard with state_impact modifies state.json when applied.
features.notes: Currently state_impact is advisory — agents may ignore it.

features.title: Agent output retry and validation
features.user_visible_behavior: If an agent writes malformed JSON or fails to write a file, the system retries once before proceeding with None.
verification: Add test: malformed JSON file is handled gracefully.
Add test: missing output file triggers retry.

features.title: Implement entity interaction logic
features.user_visible_behavior: Population entities can see each other's proposals. can_interact_with and InteractionConfig are respected in the loop.
verification: Add test: population agent prompt includes visible neighbor state.
Add test: InteractionMode.NEVER prevents cross-entity visibility.
features.notes: Schema exists but no runtime implementation.

features.title: Trajectory visualization
features.user_visible_behavior: CLI subcommand generates plots: state field timelines, outcome distributions, wildcard event markers.
verification: Run worldsim visualize on a completed run directory.
Verify plots are generated as PNG files.
features.notes: User explicitly requested visualization of evolution/changes.

features.title: End-to-end test with Claude CLI
features.user_visible_behavior: A minimal scenario completes a full loop with real Claude CLI subprocess calls.
verification: Verify trajectory.json is written with valid outcome.
features.notes: Requires claude CLI to be installed and authenticated.
